name: Javier Mendoza
bio:
Javier's motorsport journey began in the dusty karting tracks outside Valencia, where he meticulously analyzed every lap time and mechanical tweak. His innate understanding of vehicle dynamics led him to a degree in mechanical engineering, followed by a stint as a junior engineer for a small touring car team. Realizing his true passion lay in the broader strategic picture, Javier transitioned into race strategy, quickly proving his worth with clever pit stop calls and bold tire choices. He joined Anderson Racing three years ago, bringing a blend of technical insight and calculated risk-taking to the team. 

Javier's approach is defined by meticulous preparation and data analysis. He spends countless hours poring over simulations and historical race data, searching for any competitive edge. While some might find his methods overly cautious, Javier believes that informed decisions, even if conservative, are the foundation of consistent success. His ability to remain calm and focused under pressure has earned him the respect of both drivers and engineers. What sets Javier apart is his uncanny ability to predict how seemingly minor adjustments to the car's setup will translate into performance gains on the track. He strives to be the voice of reason in the high-pressure environment of a race weekend.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight wave
physical.description: Javier is of average height with a slightly stocky build, often seen with a focused expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with handwritten race notes.
Has a pre-race ritual of drinking a specific brand of Spanish coffee.
Tends to over-explain his strategies, even when the team already understands.
